summary: The Department of Justice announced convictions of members of a North Texas cell for the 4 July 2025 attack on the Prairieland ICE Detention Center in Alvarado, Texas. Fireworks were used as a diversion, vehicles and a guard structure were vandalised, and an Alvarado police lieutenant was shot in the neck when officers responded. Charges and convictions included providing material support to terrorists and attempted murder of a federal officer, and the FBI described them as the first material support to terrorism charges brought against anarchist violent extremists. The organiser was sentenced to 100 years.
rationale: On 3 July 2025 at tLTlKY5L8O4@658 he says the Father told him to warn his people that today there is a terrorist attack. An attack federally prosecuted as terrorism did occur, but on 4 July, not the day he named, and he attached no location, target, perpetrator or method to the warning. Independence Day is one of the most publicly anticipated high-threat dates in the American calendar, so a warning of an attack on 3 or 4 July carries a high base rate and would very likely have found something to match. Held at PARTIAL_MATCH rather than STRONG_MATCH for the missed day, the absence of any specific, and that base rate. Recorded in his favour that the window is genuinely tight: he said today, which is as narrow as anything in this corpus, and he gave it in advance rather than after the fact.

summary: Fixes the timing precisely: the attack took place on 4 July 2025 between approximately 10:37 and 11:05 pm CDT at the Prairieland Detention Center in Alvarado, Texas. Sixteen defendants were convicted federally as of mid-2026, with sentences from six to a hundred years, on riot, material support to terrorism, attempted murder and firearms counts.
rationale: Entered to pin the date, because the whole question on this claim is whether it landed on the day he named. It did not: he said 3 July and the attack was late on 4 July. Searches for a qualifying terrorist attack in the United States on 3 July 2025 itself returned nothing. The other half of the passage, his criticism of prophetic voices who repeat what they heard elsewhere rather than getting it from the source, is not falsifiable and is not scored here.
